2124307758572806463.en_summary: Forward P/E guys are going to be in for a reckoning. That metric is based on a projected earnings number of the future which isn’t reality yet. What happens when earnings are severely revised lower. Boom. Forward P/E skyrockets. Quoted post highlighting low forward multiples for $SNDK 2.2x, $SKHY 2.6x, $MU 2.8x, noting Sandisk can buy back half its market cap in 12 months, while $COST is 44x for hot dogs and bulk toilet paper.
2124307758572806463.zh_summary: 看遠期市盈率的人將面臨清算。該指標基於未來的預測盈利數字，尚未成為現實。當盈利被嚴重下調時會發生什麼。砰。遠期市盈率飆升。引用帖文強調 $SNDK 2.2 倍、$SKHY 2.6 倍、$MU 2.8 倍的低遠期倍數，指出 Sandisk 可在 12 個月內回購其市值的一半，而 $COST 為熱狗和 bulk toilet paper 的 44 倍。
